def UZZ1 : Prop := (∀ (m h : Type), ((HistoryOf h m) → (∀ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf m MaterialEntity t) ↔ (InstanceOf h History t)))))

def VVY1 : Prop := (∀ (h : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf h History t)) → (∃ (m : Type), (HistoryOf h m))))
/-- [woe-1] history-of is functional on first argument -/
def WOE1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((HistoryOf p q) ∧ (HistoryOf r q)) → (p = r)))
/-- [zek-1] history-of is functional on second argument -/

-- ── MaterialEntity ──
/-- [dvq-1] member-part-of is time indexed and has domain: object and range: object-aggregate -/
def DVQ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((MemberPartOf a b t) → ((InstanceOf a Object t) ∧ ((InstanceOf b ObjectAggregate t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [evk-1] An object aggregate has member parts only disjoint objects -/
def EVK1 : Prop := (∀ (b c t : Type), ((MemberPartOf b c t) ↔ (((InstanceOf b Object t) ∧ (InstanceOf c ObjectAggregate t)) ∧ ((ProperContinuantPartOf b c t) ∧ (∀ (d : Type), ((MemberPartOf d c t) → ((b = d) ∨ (¬ (∃ (z : Type), ((ContinuantPartOf z b t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf z d t)))))))))))
/-- [fsy-1] all parts of an aggregate overlap some member -/
def FSY1 : Prop := (∀ (t b x : Type), (((ProperContinuantPartOf x b t) ∧ (InstanceOf b ObjectAggregate t)) → (∃ (o : Type), ((MemberPartOf o b t) ∧ (∃ (z : Type), ((ContinuantPartOf z x t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf z o t)))))))
/-- [ibd-1] An object aggregate has more than one member at at least one time -/
def IBD1 : Prop := (∀ (ag : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf ag ObjectAggregate t)) → (∃ (o1 o2 t : Type), (((¬ (o1 = o2)) ∧ (InstanceOf o1 Object t)) ∧ ((MemberPartOf o1 ag t) ∧ ((InstanceOf o2 Object t) ∧ (MemberPartOf o2 ag t)))))))
/-- [ilw-1] Any continuant that doesn't s-depend or g-depend on something is an independant continuant -/
def ILW1 : Prop := (∀ (c1 : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf c1 IndependentContinuant t)) ↔ ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf c1 Continuant t)) ∧ (¬ (∃ (c2 t : Type), ((SpecificallyDependsOn c1 c2) ∨ (GenericallyDependsOn c1 c2 t)))))))
/-- [jrm-1] member-part-of and has-member-part are inverse relations -/
def JRM1 : Prop := (∀ (t a b : Type), ((MemberPartOf a b t) ↔ (HasMemberPart b a t)))
/-- [udu-1] i is an immaterial entity = Def. i is an independent continuant that has no material entities as parts. -/
def UDU1 : Prop := (∀ (i t : Type), ((InstanceOf i ImmaterialEntity t) ↔ ((InstanceOf i IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (∃ (m : Type), ((InstanceOf m MaterialEntity t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf m i t)))))))
/-- [uhs-1] An object aggregate always has at least one member -/
def UHS1 : Prop := (∀ (ag t : Type), ((InstanceOf ag ObjectAggregate t) → (∃ (o1 : Type), ((InstanceOf o1 Object t) ∧ (MemberPartOf o1 ag t)))))
/-- [yip-1] member-part-of is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def YIP1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((MemberPartOf p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (MemberPartOf p q s)))
/-- [yir-1] A fiat object part =def a proper part of an object -/
def YIR1 : Prop := (∀ (f t : Type), ((InstanceOf f FiatObjectPart t) ↔ (∃ (o : Type), ((InstanceOf o Object t) ∧ ((ProperContinuantPartOf f o t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf f ImmaterialEntity t)))))))

-- ── OccurrentMereology ──
/-- [aff-1] every process has a process boundary -/
def AFF1 : Prop := (∀ (p : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p Process t)) → (∃ (pb t : Type), ((InstanceOf pb ProcessBoundary t) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf pb p)))))
/-- [ccz-1] If a has-occurrent-part b then if a is an instance of process then b is an instance of process or process-boundary -/
def CCZ1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((HasOccurrentPart p q) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p Process t)) → (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf q Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf q ProcessBoundary t))))))
/-- [cmy-2] definition of temporal part for temporal regions -/
def CMY2 : Prop := (∀ (b c : Type), (((InstanceOf b TemporalRegion b) ∧ (InstanceOf c TemporalRegion c)) → ((TemporalPartOf b c) ↔ (OccurrentPartOf b c))))
/-- [csk-1] If a occurrent-part-of b then if a is an instance of process then b is an instance of process -/
def CSK1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf p q) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p Process t)) → (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf q Process t)))))
/-- [ees-1] proper-temporal-part-of has domain occurrent and range occurrent -/
def EES1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((ProperTemporalPartOf a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Occurrent t)))))
/-- [eom-2] b temporal part c (both spatiotemporal regions) iff b temporal projection is part of c's temporal projection, and for all parts of b's existence, if it spatially-projects-onto s at that time, then so does c -/
def EOM2 : Prop := (∀ (b c : Type), (((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf c SpatiotemporalRegion t))) → ((TemporalPartOf b c) ↔ (∃ (tb tc : Type), (((TemporallyProjectsOnto b tb) ∧ (TemporallyProjectsOnto c tc)) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf tb tc) ∧ (∀ (tp : Type), (((OccurrentPartOf tp tb) ∧ (∃ (s : Type), (SpatiallyProjectsOnto b s tp))) → (∃ (s : Type), ((SpatiallyProjectsOnto b s tp) ∧ (SpatiallyProjectsOnto c s tp)))))))))))
/-- [esh-2] a process boundary is any temporal part of a process that has no proper temporal parts. -/
def ESH2 : Prop := (∀ (pb t : Type), ((InstanceOf pb ProcessBoundary t) ↔ ((∃ (p : Type), ((TemporalPartOf pb p) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p Process t)))) ∧ ((OccupiesTemporalRegion pb t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalInstant t)))))
/-- [gjl-2] If a occurrent-part-of b then if a is an instance of temporal-region then b is an instance of temporal-region, and vice-versa -/
def GJL2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf p q) → ((InstanceOf p TemporalRegion p) ↔ (InstanceOf q TemporalRegion q))))
/-- [hbj-1] occurrent-part-of is reflexive -/
def HBJ1 : Prop := (∀ (a : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) → (OccurrentPartOf a a)))
/-- [hdk-1] If a has-occurrent-part b then if a is an instance of process-boundary then b is an instance of process-boundary -/
def HDK1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((HasOccurrentPart p q) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p ProcessBoundary t)) → (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf q ProcessBoundary t)))))
/-- [hpc-1] occurrent-part-of has a unique product -/
def HPC1 : Prop := (∀ (x y : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf x Occurrent t) ∧ ((InstanceOf y Occurrent t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))) → ((∃ (w : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf w x) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf w y))) → (∃ (z : Type), (∀ (w : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf w z) ↔ ((OccurrentPartOf w x) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf w y))))))))
/-- [kad-1] occurrent-part-of is transitive -/
def KAD1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c : Type), (((OccurrentPartOf a b) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf b c)) → (OccurrentPartOf a c)))
/-- [myl-1] If a occurrent-part-of b then if a is an instance of spatiotemporal-region then b is an instance of spatiotemporal-region, and vice-versa -/
def MYL1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf p q) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ↔ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf q SpatiotemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [okr-1] A proper occurrent part of b means a is an occurrent part of b and a is not the same as b -/
def OKR1 : Prop := (∀ (x y : Type), ((ProperOccurrentPartOf x y) ↔ ((OccurrentPartOf x y) ∧ (¬ (x = y)))))
/-- [ptm-1] If a occurrent-part-of b then if a is an instance of process-boundary then b is an instance of process or process-boundary -/
def PTM1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf p q) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p ProcessBoundary t)) → (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf q Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf q ProcessBoundary t))))))
/-- [qsp-1] At least one process boundary needs to be at the first or last instant of the process it bounds -/
def QSP1 : Prop := (∀ (p : Type), ((∃ (tp : Type), (InstanceOf p Process tp)) → (∃ (pb tb tp : Type), (((OccupiesTemporalRegion p tp) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf pb p)) ∧ ((OccupiesTemporalRegion pb tb) ∧ ((InstanceOf pb ProcessBoundary tb) ∧ (∃ (ltp ftp : Type), ((HasFirstInstant tp ftp) ∧ ((HasLastInstant tp ltp) ∧ ((tb = ftp) ∨ (tb = ltp)))))))))))
/-- [txf-1] Two spatiotemporal regions are parts when they are temporal parts and their spatial projects are always parts -/
def TXF1 : Prop := (∀ (st1 st2 : Type), (((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf st1 SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf st2 SpatiotemporalRegion t))) → ((OccurrentPartOf st1 st2) ↔ ((∃ (t1 t2 : Type), ((TemporallyProjectsOnto st1 t1) ∧ ((TemporallyProjectsOnto st2 t2) ∧ (TemporalPartOf t1 t2)))) ∧ (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt st1 t) → (∃ (s1 s2 tp : Type), (((TemporalPartOf tp t) ∧ (SpatiallyProjectsOnto st1 s1 tp)) ∧ ((SpatiallyProjectsOnto st2 s2 tp) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf s1 s2 tp))))))))))
/-- [wim-1] proper-occurrent-part-of and has-proper-occurrent-part are inverse relations -/
def WIM1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((ProperOccurrentPartOf a b) ↔ (HasProperOccurrentPart b a)))
/-- [xlu-1] occurrent-part-of is antisymmetric -/
def XLU1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), (((OccurrentPartOf a b) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf b a)) → (a = b)))
/-- [ybr-1] If one occurrent is part of another, then the temporal region on which the former projects is a part of the temporal region on which the latter projects -/
def YBR1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf o1 o2) → (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt o1 t) → (ExistsAt o2 t)))))
/-- [yhc-1] proper-occurrent-part-of has domain occurrent and range occurrent -/
def YHC1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((ProperOccurrentPartOf a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Occurrent t)))))
/-- [yvi-1] occurrent-part-of and has-occurrent-part are inverse relations -/
def YVI1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf a b) ↔ (HasOccurrentPart b a)))
/-- [zmr-1] occurrent-part-of has domain occurrent and range occurrent -/
def ZMR1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Occurrent t)))))

-- ── Order ──
/-- [acg-1] A last instant is either part of an extended region or is preceded by it -/
def ACG1 : Prop := (∀ (l i : Type), ((((InstanceOf l TemporalInstant l) ∧ (InstanceOf i TemporalRegion i)) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf i TemporalInstant i)) ∧ (HasLastInstant i l))) → ((¬ (TemporalPartOf l i)) ↔ (Precedes i l))))
/-- [aou-1] if one occurrent precedes another then they do not overlap temporally -/
def AOU1 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), (((Precedes p q) ∨ (Precedes q p)) → (¬ (∃ (overlap : Type), ((TemporalPartOf overlap p) ∧ (TemporalPartOf overlap q))))))
/-- [ctz-1] precedes is transitive -/
def CTZ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c : Type), (((Precedes a b) ∧ (Precedes b c)) → (Precedes a c)))
/-- [duz-1] If two processes that occupy temporal intervals do not overlap, one of them precedes the other -/
def DUZ1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 t1 t2 : Type), ((((OccupiesTemporalRegion o1 t1) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion o2 t2)) ∧ ((InstanceOf t1 TemporalInterval t1) ∧ ((InstanceOf t2 TemporalInterval t2) ∧ (¬ (∃ (part : Type), ((TemporalPartOf part t1) ∧ (TemporalPartOf part t2))))))) → ((Precedes o1 o2) ∨ (Precedes o2 o1))))
/-- [hew-1] precedes is antisymmetric -/
def HEW1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((Precedes a b) → (¬ (Precedes b a))))
/-- [miz-1] If one temporal region precedes another then the first last time point precedes the second first time point -/
def MIZ1 : Prop := (∀ (t1 t2 l1 f2 : Type), ((((Precedes t1 t2) ∧ (HasLastInstant t1 l1)) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant t2 f2) ∧ (¬ (l1 = f2)))) → (Precedes l1 f2)))
/-- [owb-1] If two temporal intervals do not overlap then one of them precedes the other -/
def OWB1 : Prop := (∀ (t1 t2 : Type), (((InstanceOf t1 TemporalInterval t1) ∧ ((InstanceOf t2 TemporalInterval t2) ∧ (¬ (∃ (part : Type), ((TemporalPartOf part t1) ∧ (TemporalPartOf part t2)))))) → ((Precedes t1 t2) ∨ (Precedes t2 t1))))
/-- [qga-1] A first instant is either part of an extended region or precedes it -/
def QGA1 : Prop := (∀ (f i : Type), ((((InstanceOf f TemporalInstant f) ∧ (InstanceOf i TemporalRegion i)) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf i TemporalInstant i)) ∧ (HasFirstInstant i f))) → ((¬ (TemporalPartOf f i)) ↔ (Precedes f i))))
/-- [qnf-1] temporal instants are totally ordered -/
def QNF1 : Prop := (∀ (t1 t2 : Type), (((InstanceOf t1 TemporalInstant t1) ∧ (InstanceOf t2 TemporalInstant t2)) → ((Precedes t1 t2) ∨ ((Precedes t2 t1) ∨ (t1 = t2)))))
/-- [qqv-1] If the last instant of a temporal region precedes the first instant of another, then the first region precedes the second -/
def QQV1 : Prop := (∀ (i1 i2 l1 f2 : Type), (((HasLastInstant i1 l1) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant i2 f2) ∧ (Precedes l1 f2))) → (Precedes i1 i2)))
/-- [rzv-1] First instant of a temporal region that is not an instant precedes last instant -/
def RZV1 : Prop := (∀ (t ft lt : Type), (((¬ (InstanceOf t TemporalInstant t)) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant t ft) ∧ (HasLastInstant t lt))) → (Precedes ft lt)))
/-- [sen-1] precedes has domain occurrent and range occurrent -/
def SEN1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((Precedes a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Occurrent t)))))
/-- [suk-1] If the last instant of a temporal region is the first instant of another, the first region precedes the second -/
def SUK1 : Prop := (∀ (i1 i2 l1 f2 : Type), ((((¬ (InstanceOf i1 TemporalInstant i1)) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf i2 TemporalInstant i2))) ∧ ((HasLastInstant i1 l1) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant i2 f2) ∧ (l1 = f2)))) → (Precedes i1 i2)))
/-- [tib-1] precedes and preceded-by are inverse relations -/
def TIB1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((Precedes a b) ↔ (PrecededBy b a)))
/-- [wff-1] If you temporally occupy part of something that precedes something else, you also precede it -/
def WFF1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 : Type), ((∃ (t1 t2 : Type), (((OccupiesTemporalRegion o1 t1) ∨ ((TemporallyProjectsOnto o1 t1) ∨ (t1 = o1))) ∧ (((OccupiesTemporalRegion o2 t2) ∨ ((TemporallyProjectsOnto o2 t2) ∨ (t2 = o2))) ∧ (Precedes t1 t2)))) ↔ (Precedes o1 o2)))
/-- [wix-1] If you are part of something that precedes something else, you also precede it -/
def WIX1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 o1p o2p : Type), (((OccurrentPartOf o1p o1) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf o2p o2) ∧ (Precedes o1 o2))) → (Precedes o1p o2p)))

-- ── Participation ──
/-- [cgn-1] At every time a specific dependent s participates in a process p there's a part of that time, during which there's an independent-continuant that s s-depends on, and that participates in p at that time -/
def CGN1 : Prop := (∀ (sdc p t : Type), (((InstanceOf sdc SpecificallyDependentContinuant t) ∧ (ParticipatesIn sdc p t)) → (∃ (tp ic : Type), (((InstanceOf tp TemporalRegion tp) ∧ ((TemporalPartOf tp t) ∧ (InstanceOf ic IndependentContinuant tp))) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf ic SpatialRegion tp)) ∧ ((SpecificallyDependsOn sdc ic) ∧ (ParticipatesIn ic p tp)))))))
/-- [ild-2] participates-in is time indexed and has domain: independent-continuant or specifically-dependent-continuant or generically-dependent-continuant  but not spatial-region and range: process -/
def ILD2 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((ParticipatesIn a b t) → ((((InstanceOf a IndependentContinuant t) ∨ ((InstanceOf a SpecificallyDependentContinuant t) ∨ (InstanceOf a GenericallyDependentContinuant t))) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf a SpatialRegion t))) ∧ ((InstanceOf b Process t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [kxe-1] If c participates in p at t and p occupies-temporal-region r then t is part of r -/
def KXE1 : Prop := (∀ (c p r t : Type), (((OccupiesTemporalRegion p r) ∧ (ParticipatesIn c p t)) → (TemporalPartOf t r)))
/-- [trl-1] At every time a process exists it has a participant -/
def TRL1 : Prop := (∀ (p t : Type), ((InstanceOf p Process t) → (∃ (c : Type), (ParticipatesIn c p t))))
/-- [xjr-1] participates-in and has-participant are inverse relations -/
def XJR1 : Prop := (∀ (t a b : Type), ((ParticipatesIn a b t) ↔ (HasParticipant b a t)))
/-- [yjm-1] participates-in is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def YJM1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((ParticipatesIn p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (ParticipatesIn p q s)))

-- ── Spatial ──
/-- [bao-1] If there are two independent continuants that are not spatial regions, and one is part of the other, then it is located in the other -/
def BAO1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((((ContinuantPartOf a b t) ∧ (InstanceOf a IndependentContinuant t)) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf a SpatialRegion t)) ∧ ((InstanceOf b IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t))))) → (LocatedIn a b t)))
/-- [bge-1] located-in is time indexed and has domain: independent-continuant but not spatial-region and range: independent-continuant but not spatial-region -/
def BGE1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((LocatedIn a b t) → (((InstanceOf a IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf a SpatialRegion t))) ∧ (((InstanceOf b IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t))) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [csx-1] occupies-spatial-region is functional on first argument -/
def CSX1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((OccupiesSpatialRegion p q r) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion s q r)) → (p = s)))
/-- [czc-1] occurs-in is lower bound location -/
def CZC1 : Prop := (∀ (p c1 c2 : Type), (((OccursIn p c1) ∧ (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt p t) ↔ ((ExistsAt c2 t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf c1 c2 t))))) → (OccursIn p c2)))
/-- [dxv-1] If a process (or process-boundary) occurs in a continuant, that continuant exists at least as long as the process does -/
def DXV1 : Prop := (∀ (p c : Type), ((OccursIn p c) → (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt p t) → (ExistsAt c t)))))
/-- [ets-1] located-in is transitive at a time -/
def ETS1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c t t2 : Type), (((LocatedIn a b t) ∧ ((LocatedIn b c t2) ∧ (TemporalPartOf t t2))) → (LocatedIn a c t)))
/-- [evu-1] located-in is a lower bound on second argument -/
def EVU1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((LocatedIn p q r) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf q s r)) → (LocatedIn p s r)))
/-- [grv-1] at all times t, there's a part of t when c occupies-spatial-region r iff every part of c occupies a part of r, and there isn't a smaller part of r that c occupies. -/
def GRV1 : Prop := (∀ (c r t : Type), (((InstanceOf c IndependentContinuant t) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf c SpatialRegion t)) ∧ (InstanceOf r SpatialRegion t))) → (∃ (t2 : Type), ((TemporalPartOf t2 t) ∧ ((OccupiesSpatialRegion c r t2) ↔ ((∀ (cp : Type), ((ContinuantPartOf cp c t2) → (∀ (rp : Type), ((OccupiesSpatialRegion cp rp t2) → (ContinuantPartOf rp r t2))))) ∧ (¬ (∃ (rprime : Type), ((¬ (rprime = r)) ∧ ((ContinuantPartOf rprime r t2) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion c rprime t2)))))))))))
/-- [hpz-1] Material entities occupy three dimensional spatial regions -/
def HPZ1 : Prop := (∀ (m t : Type), ((InstanceOf m MaterialEntity t) → (∃ (t1 s : Type), ((TemporalPartOf t1 t) ∧ ((InstanceOf s ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion t1) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion m s t1))))))
/-- [ivt-1] spatially-projects-onto is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def IVT1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((SpatiallyProjectsOnto p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (SpatiallyProjectsOnto p q s)))
/-- [jil-1] occurs-in is dissective on first argument when it is an occurrent -/
def JIL1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((OccursIn p q) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf r p)) → (OccursIn r q)))
/-- [kaw-1] located-in and location-of are inverse relations -/
def KAW1 : Prop := (∀ (t a b : Type), ((LocatedIn a b t) ↔ (LocationOf b a t)))
/-- [lzw-1] occupies-spatial-region is time indexed and has domain: independent-continuant but not spatial-region and range: spatial-region -/
def LZW1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((OccupiesSpatialRegion a b t) → (((InstanceOf a IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf a SpatialRegion t))) ∧ ((InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [mlb-1] spatial regions don't change what they are part of. -/
def MLB1 : Prop := (∀ (s sp : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf s SpatialRegion t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf sp s t))) → (∀ (t : Type), ((∃ (sPrime : Type), (ContinuantPartOf sPrime s t)) → (ContinuantPartOf sp s t)))))
/-- [mud-1] occupies-spatial-region is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def MUD1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((OccupiesSpatialRegion p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (OccupiesSpatialRegion p q s)))
/-- [put-1] located-in is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def PUT1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((LocatedIn p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (LocatedIn p q s)))
/-- [scr-1] No two material entities occupy the same space unless they coincide -/
def SCR1 : Prop := (∀ (m1 m2 s t : Type), ((((InstanceOf m1 MaterialEntity t) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion m1 s t)) ∧ ((InstanceOf m2 MaterialEntity t) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion m2 s t))) → (((ContinuantPartOf m2 m1 t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf m1 m2 t)) ∨ (m1 = m2))))
/-- [tfw-1] occurs-in has domain process or process-boundary  and range material-entity or site -/
def TFW1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccursIn a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf a Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf a ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf b MaterialEntity t) ∨ (InstanceOf b Site t))))))
/-- [uas-1] If something is located in something else then the region of the first is part of the region of the second -/
def UAS1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((LocatedIn a b t) → (∃ (r1 r2 t2 : Type), (((TemporalPartOf t2 t) ∧ (OccupiesSpatialRegion a r1 t2)) ∧ ((OccupiesSpatialRegion b r2 t2) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf r1 r2 t2))))))
/-- [uys-1] occurs-in and environs are inverse relations -/
def UYS1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccursIn a b) ↔ (Environs b a)))
/-- [wnm-1] spatial-region is the union of zero-dimensional-spatial-region, one-dimensional-spatial-region, two-dimensional-spatial-region, and three-dimensional-spatial-region -/

-- ── Spatiotemporal ──
/-- [atz-1] A process boundary occupies a spatiotemporal instant -/
def ATZ1 : Prop := (∀ (pb tr : Type), (((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf pb ProcessBoundary t)) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion pb tr)) → (InstanceOf tr TemporalInstant tr)))

def BLJ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((SpatiallyProjectsOnto a b t) → ((InstanceOf a SpatiotemporalRegion t) ∧ ((InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [bmc-1] If something occupies a temporal region, then it exists at that region -/
def BMC1 : Prop := (∀ (a t : Type), ((OccupiesTemporalRegion a t) → (ExistsAt a t)))

def CUR1 : Prop := (∀ (p t : Type), ((OccupiesTemporalRegion p t) ↔ (∃ (st : Type), ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion p st) ∧ (TemporallyProjectsOnto st t)))))
/-- [cvr-2] temporally-projects-onto has domain spatiotemporal-region and range temporal-region -/
def CVR2 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((TemporallyProjectsOnto a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ∧ (InstanceOf b TemporalRegion b))))
/-- [dki-1] process p (or boundary) occupies-spatiotemporal-region st iff every part of p  occupies-spatiotemporal-region a part of st, and there isn't a smaller part of st that p occupies. -/
def DKI1 : Prop := (∀ (o st : Type), ((((∃ (t1 : Type), (InstanceOf o Process t1)) ∨ (∃ (t1 : Type), (InstanceOf o ProcessBoundary t1))) ∧ (∃ (t1 : Type), (InstanceOf st SpatiotemporalRegion t1))) → ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion o st) ↔ ((∀ (op : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf op o) → (∀ (stp : Type), ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion op stp) → (OccurrentPartOf stp st))))) ∧ (¬ (∃ (stprime : Type), ((¬ (stprime = st)) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf stprime st) ∧ (OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion o stprime)))))))))
/-- [fdb-1] spatially-projects-onto is functional on second argument -/
def FDB1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((SpatiallyProjectsOnto p q r) ∧ (SpatiallyProjectsOnto p s r)) → (q = s)))
/-- [fzy-1] A process occupies at least a temporal interval -/
def FZY1 : Prop := (∀ (proc tr : Type), (((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf proc Process t)) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion proc tr)) → (∃ (interval : Type), ((InstanceOf interval TemporalInterval interval) ∧ (TemporalPartOf interval tr)))))
/-- [geq-1] Spatiotemporal regions always project on to some spatial region at any time -/
def GEQ1 : Prop := (∀ (st t : Type), ((InstanceOf st SpatiotemporalRegion t) → (∃ (s tp : Type), ((TemporalPartOf tp t) ∧ ((InstanceOf s SpatialRegion tp) ∧ (SpatiallyProjectsOnto st s tp))))))
/-- [iqe-1] If one process or process boundary is part of another, then their corresponding temporal regions are also in a parthood relation -/
def IQE1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 st1 st2 : Type), ((((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf o1 Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf o1 ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf o2 Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf o2 ProcessBoundary t)))) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf o1 o2) ∧ ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion o1 st1) ∧ (OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion o2 st2)))) → (OccurrentPartOf st1 st2)))
/-- [jiv-1] If one occurrent is part of another, then the temporal region of the first is part of the temporal region of the second -/
def JIV1 : Prop := (∀ (o1 o2 t1 t2 : Type), ((((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf o1 Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf o1 ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf o2 Process t))) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf o1 o2) ∧ ((OccupiesTemporalRegion o1 t1) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion o2 t2)))) → (TemporalPartOf t1 t2)))
/-- [jqz-1] exists-at is a lower bound on first argument -/
def JQZ1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((ExistsAt p q) ∧ (TemporalPartOf p r)) → (ExistsAt r q)))
/-- [jtq-1] temporally-projects-onto is functional on second argument -/
def JTQ1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((TemporallyProjectsOnto p q) ∧ (TemporallyProjectsOnto p r)) → (q = r)))
/-- [kqv-2] If a process or process boundary is part of another, their spatiotemporal regions are part too -/
def KQV2 : Prop := (∀ (p1 p2 : Type), ((((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p1 Process t)) ∨ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p1 ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p2 Process t)) ∨ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf p2 ProcessBoundary t)))) → ((OccurrentPartOf p1 p2) → (∃ (st1 st2 : Type), ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion p1 st1) ∧ ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion p2 st2) ∧ (OccurrentPartOf st1 st2)))))))
/-- [lyx-2] occupies-temporal-region has domain process or process-boundary  and range temporal-region -/
def LYX2 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccupiesTemporalRegion a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf a Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf a ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ (InstanceOf b TemporalRegion b))))
/-- [mdb-1] Every spatial region is a projection from a spatiotemporal region -/
def MDB1 : Prop := (∀ (sr : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf sr SpatialRegion t)) → (∃ (st : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf st SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (SpatiallyProjectsOnto st sr t))))))
/-- [ocw-1] If a occupies-spatial-region b then if a is an instance of material-entity then b is an instance of three-dimensional-spatial-region -/
def OCW1 : Prop := (∀ (p q t : Type), (((OccupiesSpatialRegion p q t) ∧ (InstanceOf p MaterialEntity t)) → (InstanceOf q ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion t)))
/-- [qyy-1] for every process or process boundary there's a corresponding spatiotemporal region that it occupies -/
def QYY1 : Prop := (∀ (p : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf p Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf p ProcessBoundary t))) → (∃ (s : Type), (OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion p s))))
/-- [scq-1] Spatiotemporal regions always project on to some temporal region -/
def SCQ1 : Prop := (∀ (st : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf st SpatiotemporalRegion t)) → (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t) ∧ (TemporallyProjectsOnto st t)))))
/-- [tao-1] process or process-boundary p occupies-temporal-region t iff every part of p temporally occupies a part of t, and there isn't a smaller part of t that p occupies. -/
def TAO1 : Prop := (∀ (o t : Type), ((((∃ (t1 : Type), (InstanceOf o Process t1)) ∨ (∃ (t1 : Type), (InstanceOf o ProcessBoundary t1))) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)) → ((OccupiesTemporalRegion o t) ↔ ((∀ (op : Type), ((OccurrentPartOf op o) → (∀ (tp : Type), ((OccupiesTemporalRegion op tp) → (OccurrentPartOf tp t))))) ∧ (¬ (∃ (tprime : Type), ((¬ (tprime = t)) ∧ ((OccurrentPartOf tprime t) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion o tprime)))))))))
/-- [uqb-1] If a occupies-spatial-region b then if a is an instance of site then b is an instance of three-dimensional-spatial-region -/

/-- [uqt-1] occupies-spatiotemporal-region is functional on second argument -/

/-- [vvo-1] occupies-spatiotemporal-region has domain process or process-boundary  and range spatiotemporal-region -/
def VVO1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((OccupiesSpatiotemporalRegion a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf a Process t) ∨ (InstanceOf a ProcessBoundary t))) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b SpatiotemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [wzd-1] occupies-temporal-region is functional on second argument -/
def WZD1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((OccupiesTemporalRegion p q) ∧ (OccupiesTemporalRegion p r)) → (q = r)))
/-- [xco-2] Every temporal region is a projection from a spatiotemporal region -/
def XCO2 : Prop := (∀ (tr : Type), ((InstanceOf tr TemporalRegion tr) → (∃ (st : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf st SpatiotemporalRegion t)) ∧ (TemporallyProjectsOnto st tr)))))
/-- [yex-1] occurs-in is a lower bound on second argument -/
def YEX1 : Prop := (∀ (p c1 c2 : Type), (((OccursIn p c1) ∧ (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt p t) ↔ (LocatedIn c1 c2 t)))) → (OccursIn p c2)))

-- ── SpecificDependency ──
/-- [akq-1] Definition of specifically dependent continuant. -/
def AKQ1 : Prop := (∀ (s : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf s SpecificallyDependentContinuant t)) ↔ (∃ (c t : Type), (((InstanceOf s Continuant t) ∧ (InstanceOf c IndependentContinuant t)) ∧ ((¬ (InstanceOf c SpatialRegion t)) ∧ (SpecificallyDependsOn s c))))))
/-- [bks-2] No role changes type during its existence -/
def BKS2 : Prop := (∀ (o u t1 t2 : Type), (((InstanceOf o Role t1) ∧ (InstanceOf o u t2)) → ((InstanceOf o Role t2) ∧ (InstanceOf o u t1))))
/-- [cfs-1] has-material-basis is time indexed and has domain: disposition and range: material-entity -/
def CFS1 : Prop := (∀ (a b t : Type), ((HasMaterialBasis a b t) → ((InstanceOf a Disposition t) ∧ ((InstanceOf b MaterialEntity t) ∧ (InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t)))))
/-- [dbp-1] DEFINITION: b is a relational quality = Def. b is a quality and there exists distinct c and d such that at all times t, b inheres in c if and only b specifically-depends-on. -/
def DBP1 : Prop := (∀ (b : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b RelationalQuality t)) ↔ ((∃ (c d : Type), ((¬ (c = d)) ∧ ((InheresIn b c) ∧ (SpecificallyDependsOn b d)))) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Quality t)))))
/-- [dzz-1] inheres-in and bearer-of are inverse relations -/
def DZZ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((InheresIn a b) ↔ (BearerOf b a)))
/-- [grx-1] When a realizable entity is realized, the bearer of the thing realized participates in the realization process -/
def GRX1 : Prop := (∀ (r p b : Type), (((Realizes p r) ∧ (InheresIn r b)) → (∃ (t : Type), (ParticipatesIn b p t))))
/-- [hnl-1] has-material-basis is dissective on third argument, a temporal region -/
def HNL1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r s : Type), (((HasMaterialBasis p q r) ∧ (TemporalPartOf s r)) → (HasMaterialBasis p q s)))
/-- [iyu-1] If s s-depends-on c then there's at least one time when they both exist and whenever s exists, c must also exist -/
def IYU1 : Prop := (∀ (s c : Type), ((SpecificallyDependsOn s c) → ((∃ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt s t) ∧ (ExistsAt c t))) ∧ (∀ (t : Type), ((ExistsAt s t) → (ExistsAt c t))))))
/-- [kkl-1] specifically-depends-on has domain specifically-dependent-continuant and range specifically-dependent-continuant or independent-continuant but not spatial-region -/
def KKL1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((SpecificallyDependsOn a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a SpecificallyDependentContinuant t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf b SpecificallyDependentContinuant t) ∨ ((InstanceOf b IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t))))))))
/-- [myu-1] specifically-depends-on is transitive -/
def MYU1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c : Type), (((SpecificallyDependsOn a b) ∧ ((SpecificallyDependsOn b c) ∧ (¬ (a = c)))) → (SpecificallyDependsOn a c)))
/-- [nfe-1] if s s-depends_on c then s and c never share common parts (s,c continuants) -/
def NFE1 : Prop := (∀ (s c : Type), ((SpecificallyDependsOn s c) → (¬ (∃ (w t : Type), ((ContinuantPartOf w s t) ∧ (ContinuantPartOf w c t))))))
/-- [oot-1] realizes has domain process and range realizable-entity -/
def OOT1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((Realizes a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Process t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b RealizableEntity t)))))
/-- [pvk-1] realizes and has-realization are inverse relations -/
def PVK1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((Realizes a b) ↔ (HasRealization b a)))
/-- [tht-1] a inheres_in b =Def. a is a specifically dependent continuant and b is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region and a s-depends_on b. -/
def THT1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((InheresIn a b) ↔ ((SpecificallyDependsOn a b) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf a SpecificallyDependentContinuant t) ∧ ((InstanceOf b IndependentContinuant t) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf b SpatialRegion t))))))))
/-- [tla-1] has-material-basis and material-basis-of are inverse relations -/
def TLA1 : Prop := (∀ (t a b : Type), ((HasMaterialBasis a b t) ↔ (MaterialBasisOf b a t)))
/-- [uxo-1] The material basis of a disposition is part of the bearer of the disposition -/
def UXO1 : Prop := (∀ (m d b : Type), ((((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf m MaterialEntity t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf d Disposition t))) ∧ ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b MaterialEntity t)) ∧ (InheresIn d b))) → (∀ (t : Type), ((HasMaterialBasis d m t) → (ContinuantPartOf m b t)))))
/-- [vhg-1] A realizable entity exists at least at the beginning of the realization process -/
def VHG1 : Prop := (∀ (r p : Type), ((Realizes p r) → (∃ (proct first : Type), ((OccupiesTemporalRegion p proct) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant proct first) ∧ (ExistsAt r first))))))
/-- [yct-1] specifically-depends-on and specifically-depended-on-by are inverse relations -/
def YCT1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((SpecificallyDependsOn a b) ↔ (SpecificallyDependedOnBy b a)))

-- ── TemporalRegion ──
/-- [aeu-1] a proper temporal part of b means a is a temporal part of b and b a is not the same as b -/
def AEU1 : Prop := (∀ (x y : Type), ((ProperTemporalPartOf x y) ↔ ((TemporalPartOf x y) ∧ (¬ (x = y)))))
/-- [aqu-1] proper-temporal-part-of is asymmetric -/
def AQU1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((ProperTemporalPartOf a b) → (¬ (ProperTemporalPartOf b a))))
/-- [bal-1] temporal-part-of for occurrents implies occurrent-part-of -/
def BAL1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((TemporalPartOf a b) → (OccurrentPartOf a b)))
/-- [bfq-1] temporal-part-of is transitive -/
def BFQ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c : Type), (((TemporalPartOf a b) ∧ (TemporalPartOf b c)) → (TemporalPartOf a c)))
/-- [bnt-2] If a has-temporal-part b then if a is an instance of zero-dimensional-temporal-region then b is an instance of zero-dimensional-temporal-region -/
def BNT2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((HasTemporalPart p q) → ((InstanceOf p ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion p) → (InstanceOf q ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion q))))
/-- [bon-1] has-first-instant and first-instant-of are inverse relations -/
def BON1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((HasFirstInstant a b) ↔ (FirstInstantOf b a)))
/-- [boo-1] temporal-part-of and has-temporal-part are inverse relations -/
def BOO1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((TemporalPartOf a b) ↔ (HasTemporalPart b a)))
/-- [bvr-1] temporal-part-of is reflexive -/
def BVR1 : Prop := (∀ (a : Type), ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) → (TemporalPartOf a a)))
/-- [cop-1] intervals have no gaps - strong version - every two instants without another in between bound an interval -/
def COP1 : Prop := (∀ (i start end_ : Type), (((InstanceOf i TemporalInterval i) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant i start) ∧ (HasLastInstant i end_))) → (∀ (t1 t2 : Type), ((((TemporalPartOf t1 i) ∧ ((TemporalPartOf t2 i) ∧ (InstanceOf t1 TemporalInstant t1))) ∧ ((InstanceOf t2 TemporalInstant t2) ∧ ((Precedes t1 t2) ∧ (¬ (∃ (t3 : Type), ((InstanceOf t3 TemporalInstant t3) ∧ ((Precedes t1 t3) ∧ (Precedes t3 t2)))))))) → (∃ (fill : Type), (((InstanceOf fill TemporalInterval fill) ∧ (HasFirstInstant fill t1)) ∧ ((HasLastInstant fill t2) ∧ (TemporalPartOf fill i))))))))
/-- [daf-1] any temporal region has a first and last instant -/
def DAF1 : Prop := (∀ (i : Type), ((InstanceOf i TemporalRegion i) → (∃ (t1 t2 : Type), ((HasFirstInstant i t1) ∧ (HasLastInstant i t2)))))
/-- [dbc-1] proper-temporal-part-of and has-proper-temporal-part are inverse relations -/
def DBC1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((ProperTemporalPartOf a b) ↔ (HasProperTemporalPart b a)))
/-- [dbj-2] temporal-part-of is reflexive -/
def DBJ2 : Prop := (∀ (a : Type), ((InstanceOf a TemporalRegion a) → (TemporalPartOf a a)))
/-- [eeg-2] If a has-temporal-part b then if a is an instance of one-dimensional-temporal-region then b is an instance of one-dimensional-temporal-region or zero-dimensional-temporal-region -/
def EEG2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((HasTemporalPart p q) → ((InstanceOf p OneDimensionalTemporalRegion p) → ((InstanceOf q OneDimensionalTemporalRegion q) ∨ (InstanceOf q ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion q)))))
/-- [ekm-1] intervals have no internal gaps -/
def EKM1 : Prop := (∀ (i start end_ : Type), (((InstanceOf i TemporalInterval i) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant i start) ∧ (HasLastInstant i end_))) → (¬ (∃ (gap gapStart gapEnd : Type), (((HasFirstInstant gap gapStart) ∧ (HasLastInstant gap gapEnd)) ∧ ((Precedes gapEnd end_) ∧ ((Precedes start gapStart) ∧ (¬ (TemporalPartOf gap i)))))))))
/-- [fwf-1] has-first-instant is functional on second argument -/
def FWF1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((HasFirstInstant p q) ∧ (HasFirstInstant p r)) → (q = r)))
/-- [fwk-2] has-first-instant has domain temporal-region and range temporal-instant -/
def FWK2 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((HasFirstInstant a b) → ((InstanceOf a TemporalRegion a) ∧ (InstanceOf b TemporalInstant b))))
/-- [hgs-1] temporal-region is the union of zero-dimensional-temporal-region and one-dimensional-temporal-region -/
def HGS1 : Prop := (∀ (i t : Type), ((InstanceOf i TemporalRegion t) → ((InstanceOf i ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion t) ∨ (InstanceOf i OneDimensionalTemporalRegion t))))
/-- [ixz-1] The first temporal instant is such that it precedes every part of the interval that doesn't have the first instant as part -/
def IXZ1 : Prop := (∀ (fi i : Type), (((InstanceOf fi TemporalInstant fi) ∧ ((InstanceOf i TemporalRegion i) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf i TemporalInstant i)))) → ((HasFirstInstant i fi) → (∀ (ip : Type), (((TemporalPartOf ip i) ∧ (¬ (TemporalPartOf fi ip))) → (Precedes fi ip))))))
/-- [jhe-2] A one-dimensional temporal region has at least one interval as part -/
def JHE2 : Prop := (∀ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf t OneDimensionalTemporalRegion t) → (∃ (p : Type), ((TemporalPartOf p t) ∧ (InstanceOf p TemporalInterval p)))))
/-- [jtk-2] has-last-instant has domain temporal-region and range temporal-instant -/
def JTK2 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((HasLastInstant a b) → ((InstanceOf a TemporalRegion a) ∧ (InstanceOf b TemporalInstant b))))
/-- [mei-2] If a temporal-part-of b then if a is an instance of one-dimensional-temporal-region then b is an instance of one-dimensional-temporal-region -/
def MEI2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((TemporalPartOf p q) → ((InstanceOf p OneDimensionalTemporalRegion p) → (InstanceOf q OneDimensionalTemporalRegion q))))
/-- [mjn-2] If a temporal-part-of b then if a is an instance of temporal-region then b is an instance of temporal-region, and vice-versa -/
def MJN2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), ((TemporalPartOf p q) → ((InstanceOf p TemporalRegion p) ↔ (InstanceOf q TemporalRegion q))))
/-- [mns-1] proper-temporal-part-of is transitive -/
def MNS1 : Prop := (∀ (a b c : Type), (((ProperTemporalPartOf a b) ∧ (ProperTemporalPartOf b c)) → (ProperTemporalPartOf a c)))
/-- [mvd-1] All temporal regions are part of a temporal interval -/
def MVD1 : Prop := (∀ (t : Type), ((InstanceOf t TemporalRegion t) → (∃ (i : Type), ((InstanceOf i TemporalInterval i) ∧ (TemporalPartOf t i)))))
/-- [nfo-1] The first and last time points for an instant are the instant itself -/
def NFO1 : Prop := (∀ (i : Type), ((InstanceOf i TemporalInstant i) ↔ ((HasFirstInstant i i) ∧ (HasLastInstant i i))))
/-- [nhd-2] The last temporal instant is such that every part of the interval that doesn't have the last instant as part precedes it -/
def NHD2 : Prop := (∀ (li i : Type), (((InstanceOf li TemporalInstant li) ∧ ((InstanceOf i TemporalRegion i) ∧ (¬ (InstanceOf i TemporalInstant i)))) → ((HasLastInstant i li) → (∀ (ip : Type), (((TemporalPartOf ip i) ∧ (¬ (TemporalPartOf li ip))) → (Precedes ip li))))))
/-- [njq-1] If something is an instance of temporal region at t, then t is part of that temporal region -/
def NJQ1 : Prop := (∀ (ti t : Type), ((InstanceOf ti TemporalRegion t) → (TemporalPartOf t ti)))
/-- [nui-1] An interval has no gaps -/
def NUI1 : Prop := (∀ (i start end_ : Type), (((InstanceOf i TemporalInterval i) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant i start) ∧ (HasLastInstant i end_))) → (¬ (∃ (gap gapStart gapEnd : Type), (((¬ (InstanceOf gap TemporalInstant gap)) ∧ ((HasFirstInstant gap gapStart) ∧ (HasLastInstant gap gapEnd))) ∧ (((Precedes gapEnd end_) ∨ ((TemporalPartOf end_ i) ∧ (gapEnd = end_))) ∧ (((Precedes start gapStart) ∨ ((TemporalPartOf start i) ∧ (gapStart = start))) ∧ (¬ (TemporalPartOf gap i)))))))))
/-- [ogd-1] has-last-instant is functional on second argument -/
def OGD1 : Prop := (∀ (p q r : Type), (((HasLastInstant p q) ∧ (HasLastInstant p r)) → (q = r)))
/-- [pir-2] The only part of a temporal instant is itself -/
def PIR2 : Prop := (∀ (p q : Type), (((InstanceOf p TemporalInstant p) ∧ (HasTemporalPart p q)) → (p = q)))
/-- [ruj-1] temporal-part-of has domain occurrent and range occurrent -/
def RUJ1 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((TemporalPartOf a b) → ((∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf a Occurrent t)) ∧ (∃ (t : Type), (InstanceOf b Occurrent t)))))
/-- [tvx-3] temporal regions are instances at themselves -/
def TVX3 : Prop := (∀ (a b : Type), ((∀ (c : Type), (((InstanceOf a b c) ∧ (InstanceOf a TemporalRegion c)) → (InstanceOf a b a))) ∧ ((InstanceOf a b a) → (InstanceOf a TemporalRegion a))))
